topic: How your touchscreen knows it's your finger (sausage story first)

lines.say: In February twenty-ten, South Koreans were reported tapping iPhones with snack sausages, to keep their gloves on.
lines.show: In February 2010, South Koreans were reported tapping iPhones with *snack sausages,* to keep [their gloves on.]

lines.say: Because your phone ignores a wool glove, however hard you press. So what is your screen feeling for?
lines.show: Because your phone ignores a *wool glove,* however hard you press. So what is your screen [feeling for?]

lines.say: Under the glass sits an invisible grid of see-through wires: rows one way, columns the other.
lines.show: Under the glass sits an *invisible grid* of see-through wires: rows one way, [columns the other.]

lines.say: The phone sends tiny electric pulses along the rows, and measures what reaches each column, many times a second.
lines.show: The phone sends tiny *electric pulses* along the rows, and measures what reaches each column, [many times a second.]

lines.say: Your finger is mostly salty water, so charge moves through it. Bring it close, and it draws away part of the signal at the crossings under it.
lines.show: Your finger is mostly *salty water,* so charge moves through it. Bring it close, and it draws away part of the signal [at the crossings under it.]

lines.say: By comparing neighbouring crossings, the phone finds the centre of your touch, even between wires.
lines.show: By comparing neighbouring crossings, the phone finds the *centre of your touch,* [even between wires.]

lines.say: A wool glove or a fingernail barely changes the signal. Water can, so a wet screen sometimes taps by itself.
lines.show: A wool glove or a fingernail *barely changes* the signal. Water can, so a wet screen sometimes [taps by itself.]

lines.say: And the sausage? Salty, moist meat changes that signal too. Your screen never knew it was your finger. It only feels a change in the signal, and a sausage can fake that.
lines.show: And the sausage? *Salty, moist meat* changes that signal too. Your screen never knew it was your finger. It only feels a change in the signal, and [a sausage can fake that.]
